items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: Freddie plays all kind of music.

ctx.x: What kind of music did you play, personally? I used to play piano. No, but I mean, did you play Dixieland or Progressive or everything?

Well, after I got with them I used to play at Dixieland, but I started out with music, see? I started out with music. No, you don't play Dixieland. Freddie, no, no, not about Dixieland. You don't know about Dixieland. No, I said, I played that, not no, Dixieland. Used to play rock and roll. And rock and roll with them, see? Mm-hmm. But before, before I was in the opera. Freddie plays all kind of music.
Mm-hmm. He's a singer, too, because he learned that at school.
